violations.text: The bar area is lacking a hand-washing sink. New Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2026

The presence of rodents are not controlled as evidenced by large droppings in basement area. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2026
Hot water handle (right faucet) at 3 bay sink was not operable. Plumbing systems to be maintained in good repair and proper adjustment. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 03/05/2025
The following areas are in poor repair. - basement walls (holes) - basement floors (holes) The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 11/30/2026
The floor in the basement area has an accumulation of soil and rat droppings. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2026
The establishment does not have a written procedure for cleaning vomit and diarrhea. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/19/2025

Raw animal foods (eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (cheese, deli meats) in the reach-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/19/2025
At time of inspection, deli meats and cheese were observed with date mark of 2/6 which exceeds the 7 days. New Violation. Correct By: 03/05/2025

Inspector observed the following to be in poor repair: 1. The faucet at the mop sink was observed being held together with tape. 2. Hot water handle at 3 bay sink was not operable. Plumbing systems to be maintained in good repair and proper adjustment. New Violation. Correct By: 03/05/2025
